confidence_notes: July city-price data supports the meal, beer and coffee estimates. Cocktail prices vary; wine is estimated at roughly twice draft-beer prices. Accommodation is a holistic estimate based on the supplied city comparisons and is less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: For year-typical lodging, Denver is estimated above San Antonio and below Honolulu, with three-star hotel rates near Santa Fe and New Orleans. Basic rooms are estimated below Santa Fe and New Orleans but above San Antonio.
